The Gravity Well

A spaceport bar with a long copper counter and travel posters from a dozen ports curling on the walls. The drinks are real, and so are the prices. At the far end a man in a good coat is telling a story about the sea to a table of freight hands, and he is paying for every round.

Somebody has started a game of dominoes. It has been going an hour, and two people have stopped speaking.
is sketching a drive modification on a napkin for anyone who will look.
is at a corner table, doing something to the bar's jukebox.
